title: FrameflowPublishPackage
description: What goes beside a finished video when it is posted on YouTube. Each chapter after the first starts at a moment of the recording, so its time follows the cut when the project changes. YouTube's limits on lengths are checked in publish.py.

description.description: For viewers, without times: the chapter list is added after it.

chapters.description: Optional: none for a Short or a video without distinct parts. The first starts the video and takes only a title.

at.description: Seconds into the recording where the chapter starts: where its first phrase starts.
